## Production Systems

- [BrollyHub Academia](https://academia.brollyhub.com): Multi-role expert marketplace with real-time communication and transactional workflows. 500+ users, 15k+ API requests/day, 100+ concurrent WebSocket connections. Stack: Django REST, React, PostgreSQL, WebSockets, Google Cloud.
- [RenoSmarterAI](https://renosmarter.ai): AI renovation platform with multi-step cost estimation and vector-based material matching. 81% pricing accuracy, 99%+ uptime, 40% user task completion increase. Stack: Django REST, React TypeScript, Pinecone, GPT-4o, Gemini.
- [Rauf Denktas University](https://rdu.edu.tr): University platform with student/faculty portals and content management. 2,000+ daily active users, 50k+ monthly page views, 55% faster page loads. Stack: Django, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Nginx.
- [Aveem University](https://aveem.net): University management system with role-based access and real-time data synchronization. 2,000+ users, 5 RBAC levels, real-time sync. Stack: Django, React, PostgreSQL, WebSockets.
